slow_push.description: Slow, inexorable forward push toward subject (scale 100% -> 105%), building psychological intimacy or mounting tension.

slow_pull.description: Gradual pull out revealing broader spatial isolation or overwhelming environmental scale.

horizontal_drift.description: Lateral translation across workstation, server bay, or document lines.

macro_focus.description: Extreme close-up on physical mechanical switches, single terminal characters, or cursor pixels.

locked_off.description: Stationary framing reserved for document scrutiny, terminal failure output, or tension holds.

parallactic_orbit.description: Blender 3D spatial orbit around server racks or agent control loops with foreground occlusion.
